name: debugAdd
description: Appends rows to the Generic data section of the debug footer. The supported channel for app code and frameworks to inject their own debug panel. Two call forms: debugAdd( category, struct ) adds each key/value of the struct as a row, or debugAdd( category, name, value ) adds a single named row.

params.name: category
params.description: A category label; rows are grouped under it in the footer's Generic data section.

params.name: name
params.description: The row name, or (in the two-argument form) a struct of name/value pairs.

examples.title: Inject a custom debug panel
examples.description: Add controller and cache information to the footer when debug is on.
